# Fixture: dispcal 校准进度输出
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS dispcal 校准过程输出
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: dispcal -v -d 1 -c 1 -q m -t 6500 -g 2.2 output

# ========== 启动阶段 ==========
ArgyllCMS dispcal - Display calibration utility
Version 2.2.1

Display 1: 'LCD Monitor' at 1920x1080
Instrument: 'i1 Display Pro' at port 1
Using spectral sample file: /path/to/ArgyllCMS/ref/i1d3ss.ccss

# ========== 仪器初始化 ==========
Setting up instrument ...
Serial Number: XXXXXXXX
Initial calibration ...

# ========== 用户放置探头提示 ==========
Place instrument on test window.
Hit Esc or Q to abort, any other key to continue:

# ========== 校准开始 ==========
Commencing display calibration ...
Reading patch 1 of 21 ...

# ========== 进度输出 ==========
# 格式: "patch X of Y" 表示进度
# dispcal 通常测量灰阶和关键色块

Reading patch 2 of 21 ...
Reading patch 3 of 21 ...
...
Reading patch 10 of 21 ...
Reading patch 11 of 21 ...

# ========== 计算阶段 ==========
Computing calibration curves ...
Creating VCGT (Video Card Gamma Table) ...

# ========== Web Server 模式输出 ==========
# 如果使用 -dweb:9292 参数:
Created web server at 'http://192.168.1.20:9292/', now waiting for browser to connect

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 进度解析正则: r'patch\s+(\d+)\s+of\s+(\d+)'
# 提取: current_patch = match.group(1), total_patches = match.group(2)
# 进度计算: 15 + int(55 * current_patch / total_patches) -> 15-70%

# 关键阶段检测:
# - "Commencing display calibration" -> 开始校准 (15%)
# - "patch X of Y" -> 测量色块 (15-70%)
# - "Computing calibration curves" -> 计算曲线 (70%)
# - "Creating VCGT" -> 创建 VCGT (80%)
# - "Written" + ".cal" -> 完成 (100%)

# ========== Web Server 模式检测 ==========
# 正则: r"'(http://[^']+)'"
# 提取 URL，用于前端显示或客户端连接
# 触发 on_web_server_url 回调
